meta.note: Dining options are NOT included in holiday package budgets. They are shown as nearby suggestions only. Price bands: $ = quick/affordable ($8-18pp), $$ = casual family dining ($18-35pp), $$$ = premium ($35-60+pp). Opening hours may vary — check before visiting.

venues.name: Betty's Burgers & Concrete Co
venues.notes: Cult burger chain. Kids love the concrete custard ice cream desserts. Fast, casual, consistent.

venues.name: Guzman y Gomez
venues.notes: Fast, fresh Mexican. Kids' menu, good value burrito bowls, multiple locations. Quick lunch solution.

venues.name: Fisho's Fish & Chips
venues.notes: Takeaway fish and chips. Grab a family pack, walk 2min to the beach for a sunset picnic.

venues.name: Sushi Train
venues.notes: Conveyor-belt sushi. Kids love watching plates go past. Pick what you want, pay per plate colour ($3.50-$7).

venues.name: Shiraz Persian Restaurant
venues.notes: Generous Persian grilled meats, rice, bread. Family platters great value. Something different, very kid-friendly staff.

venues.name: Hard Rock Cafe
venues.notes: Legendary burgers, ribs, fajitas. Music memorabilia everywhere. Kids' menu. Fun, loud, no need to be quiet.

venues.name: Hurricane's Grill & Bar
venues.notes: Famous for fall-off-the-bone pork ribs and steaks. Beachfront dining. Special occasion family dinner.

venues.name: Seascape Restaurant + Bar
venues.notes: Beachfront fine dining. Three levels — Bistro ($$), Restaurant ($$$), Rooftop Bar. Stunning ocean views.

venues.name: Kurry Kulture
venues.notes: Modern Indian. Butter chicken and naan is a family crowd-pleaser. Generous portions, mild kids' options available.

venues.name: Kurrawa Surf Club
venues.notes: Classic surf club on the sand. Steak, parmy, fish & chips, kids' meals ~$12. Best-value beachfront dining. Views unbeatable.

venues.name: Social Eating House + Bar
venues.notes: Trendy share-plate dining. Date-night energy but early sittings fine with kids. Excellent food, great service.

venues.name: The Lamb Shop
venues.notes: Fast-casual Greek yiros and souvlaki. Quick, tasty, affordable. Kids devour the lamb yiros. Just off the beach.

venues.name: Gemelli Italian
venues.notes: Beloved local Italian. Wood-fired pizzas, handmade pasta. Family-friendly, book ahead — always packed for good reason.

venues.name: Moo Moo Restaurant & Wine Bar
venues.notes: Premium steakhouse. Special occasion. Kids' steak available. Dress up a bit. One of the Coast's best restaurants.

venues.name: Broadbeach Surf Pavilion
venues.notes: Casual beachside cafe. Burgers, fish & chips, smoothies, ice cream. Cheap, cheerful, metres from the sand.

venues.name: Pancakes in Paradise
venues.notes: All-day pancake house in central Surfers. Sweet and savoury pancakes, crepes, waffles. Kids' menu with mini pancakes. Dessert heaven.

venues.name: Southport Sharks
venues.notes: Huge family-friendly club — massive bistro, playground, kids' movie room, sports bar. Cheap kids' meals ($10). Great wet-weather option.

venues.name: Danny Boys
venues.notes: 50s-style diner with massive burgers, loaded fries, milkshakes. Fun decor, rock'n'roll playing. Coolangatta institution.

venues.name: Greenmount Beach Surf Club
venues.notes: Beachfront surf club with absolute ocean views. Family bistro, kids' play area, great seafood. Watch surfers while you eat.

venues.name: Bine Bar & Dining
venues.notes: Cool local spot — craft beer, excellent burgers, relaxed vibe. Not specifically a kids' restaurant but very family-accepting.

venues.name: Rick Shores
venues.notes: Right on Burleigh beach with waves almost at your table. Famous bug rolls (Moreton Bay bug). Book months ahead or walk-in for lunch. Incredible experience.

venues.name: Burleigh Pavilion
venues.notes: Iconic beachfront venue — The Tropic restaurant ($$$) or The Terrace ($$, walk-in). Pizza, fish & chips, cold drinks, sunset views. Kids welcome in The Terrace.

venues.name: Commune Cafe
venues.notes: Retro cafe in Burleigh's James Street village. Great coffee, big breakfasts, relaxed vibe. Outdoor seating under trees. Breakfast/lunch only.

venues.name: Miami Fish Market
venues.notes: Fresh seafood market with eat-in fish & chips, oysters, grilled fish. Pick your fish from the counter. Casual, fresh, very local. BYO drinks.

venues.name: Alfresco Italian Restaurant
venues.notes: Family-owned Surfers institution. Pizza, pasta, generous mains. Very kid-welcoming. Garlic bread a must. Reasonable prices.

venues.name: Helensvale Night Quarter Markets
venues.notes: Massive weekend food markets (Sat 4-10pm). 100+ food stalls, live music, kids' zone, pony rides sometimes. Huge variety — feed everyone what they want.

venues.name: Domino's Pizza (various locations)
venues.notes: Cheap pizza for the night you can't be bothered. $5 value pizzas, delivery or pickup. Multiple locations across the Coast.

venues.name: The Fish House
venues.notes: Exceptional seafood on Burleigh beach. Kids' fish & chips available. Book ahead. A treat dinner for the last night of holidays.

venues.name: Iyara Thai
venues.notes: Excellent Thai in Broadbeach. Pad Thai, green curry, satay skewers — reliable crowd-pleasers. Mild options for kids. Good value.

venues.name: Bam Bam Bakehouse
venues.notes: Famous bakery and cafe. Now in Robina. Croissants, pies, epic donuts, great coffee. Perfect family breakfast or lunch stop. The donuts are legendary.
